resources.string: Start the engine and tap Start measuring
Sound too weak – move the phone closer
Could not open the microphone – try again
Why does the app need the microphone?
The rpm is calculated from the rhythm of the firing pulses in the engine noise. The app only listens – it records, stores and sends nothing, and works completely offline.
Idle not specified in the manual
Motorcycle not in the list – enter the idle speed from its manual
Enter the specified idle speed from your motorcycle\'s manual. If the manual gives a single number, enter it in both fields.
Enter values from %1$s to %2$s; “from” must not be higher than “to”.

Values come from the manufacturers\' manuals. Entries marked “approximate” could not be checked directly in the manual – compare them with your motorcycle\'s manual before adjusting. The tachometer measures single-cylinder engines.
The solid green band %1$s rpm is the specified idle speed for %2$s.
The solid green band %1$s rpm is the idle speed you entered for your custom motorcycle.
The manual for %1$s gives no idle speed figure. Set the lowest idle at which the engine runs steadily without stalling.
The manual gives a single number without tolerance, so the app also counts ±%1$d rpm as “in range” – that is the measurement accuracy, not a manufacturer figure.
The red line at %1$s rpm is the run-in limit from the manual.
The light band is your working range. Manufacturers usually do not specify it, so the default 3,500 – 7,000 is just a starting point – adjust it to how you actually ride.
Hold the phone about half a metre from the exhaust outlet, not directly in the gas stream. Measurement is most accurate at steady rpm.
If the signal match drops below 40% or the sound is too weak, the number freezes – there is too much noise around or the motorcycle is too far away.
Approximate value, not checked directly in the manual (source: %1$s). Compare it with your manual before adjusting.
